# VideoGen founder Anton Koenig interviewed on AI for Everyone


VideoGen founder Anton Koenig joins AI for Everyone to discuss building an AI video startup, Y Combinator, distribution, and scaling.


VideoGen founder Anton Koenig joined Aditya on AI for Everyone for "Building an AI Video Startup: VideoGen Founder on YC, Distribution & Scaling."


Thank you to Aditya and AI for Everyone for featuring VideoGen and sharing the founder story with their audience. The conversation covers building an AI video startup, going through Y Combinator, finding distribution, and scaling a product in a fast-moving AI market.
